title: Letter to myself in late 2008: how to survive a crisis, from imeem's CEO
summary: Dalton Caldwell writes to his 2008 self, then CEO of imeem with ~90 employees and high burn. The lessons: stop counting on fundraising, use the cash you have, renegotiate every contract, cut once and deeply to reach profitability, and make decisions yourself instead of averaging advice.

principles.text: Stop planning around future fundraising; work with the cash you actually have.
principles.quote: Stop thinking or talking about future fundraising. This entire line of thinking will lead to lots of wasted cycles.
